name: Standard of Valiance expires with its own 20 second duration (#6738)
contract: #6738: 'Skill states the Standard lasts 20 seconds, was still standing and pulsing damage after well over 5 Minutes.' The Standard of Valiance cast spell 803936 has DurationIndex 18, SpellDuration 20000 ms, so its own tooltip line 'Throw down a Standard of Valiance for $d' renders 20 seconds and the summon is supposed to last that long: spell_ascension_guardian_standard::Summon reads GetSpellInfo()->GetDuration() (AscensionGuardianStandards.cpp line 190), applies SPELLMOD_DURATION, and passes it as the despawn time to SummonCreature. It passed TEMPSUMMON_TIMED_OR_DEAD_DESPAWN, and core resets that type's timer to full whenever the summon is in combat or not alive (TemporarySummon.cpp, case TEMPSUMMON_TIMED_OR_DEAD_DESPAWN: 'else if (m_timer != m_lifetime) m_timer = m_lifetime;'). A Valiance standard damages nearby enemies every 2 s through field aura 501543, so it is permanently in combat with whatever it pulses on and its timer never runs down - which is why it stood and pulsed for minutes on end. This scenario places the standard within reach of a training dummy so the pulse puts it in combat, then checks the summoned creature 60062 is gone after the 20 s the spell promises. Expected before the fix: still standing 25 s after the cast. Expected after: unsummoned.

steps.label: Keep the owner alive so the standard cannot be cleaned up by the 500 ms owner check
Place the Standard of Valiance inside the dummy's reach so its 2 s damage pulse keeps it in combat
SETUP: the Valiance standard creature 60062 is standing
Wait 5 s past the 20 s the spell's own tooltip promises
#6738: the standard is gone once the 20 s duration it advertises has passed
